report.answer_text:
Presbyopia can be corrected with reading glasses. Their positive-power (convex) lenses help you focus on nearby objects. If you also need glasses for distance, bifocals or progressive lenses can correct both near and distance vision in the same pair. Multifocal contact lenses are another option. (nei.nih.gov)
These options compensate for the age-related loss of flexibility in the eye’s natural lens; they don’t reverse it. An eye exam can confirm presbyopia and determine the right lens strength. (nei.nih.gov)
